title: Restore only what the learner did
statement: Restore a learner's place after a reload, Back or mode switch only from a record of what they actually did, so returning neither erases earned progress nor grants unearned credit.
detail: Native checks of a Grade 3 course found an ordinary reload that lost an earned step and relocked the page, because its progress sat in a bare key outside the lesson's reading-phase state (`grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/BEAD-REGISTER.json`, line 1147). A switch to reviewer mode and back relocked a completed answer with the status 'Give your answer first', while a real reload repaired it (line 2083). In the other direction, reviewer answers carried into student mode as a correct mark and an open gate (line 663). Text drafts were made to survive reload and page return, and a regression now asserts across reload, pending, outage, identity and reviewer cases that no gate is restored (`grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/BEAD-REGISTER.md`, line 27; `grade3-reading/ui-audit-2026-09-08/gold-standard/draft-action-regression.log`, line 20).

evidence.quote: Ordinary reload loses that earned tail and relocks the page.
Tail progress uses local tailT plus a bare :tails done key outside the existing reading-phase owner.
Toggle reviewer on, then student on without editing or answering. The exact accepted transcript returns, but settled Next has aria-disabled=true and status Give your answer first.
A real reload repairs the gate, and a second reviewer return reproduces it.
